_readme: Not a valid Air import manifest on its own — this is a holding pen for node definitions removed from topology.json, kept here so they aren't lost. When ready to add them back: merge the objects under "nodes" below into topology.json's content.nodes, delete this _readme key from what you paste, then do the required delete + fresh re-import (see README.md's 'Adding a worker node?' section for why it has to be a fresh import, not a live patch).
